verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a self-hosted auth framework that stores user data, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented user/account deletion feature and no retention or purge policy. Session expiry settings, session revocation and API-key expiration are adjacent authentication-lifetime controls, not data-retention controls. Community remarks that 'you own all the data' in your own database describe the developer's hosting arrangement, not a product capability, so none of these earn credit.
